items.answer: independent-period
items.explanation: 主语是 Globalization，谓语是 means；意思已经说完整。 因此选择独立分句，并在原句末补句号。

missions.title: Chapter 10 · Practice 3 · But versus Yet
missions.instructions: 在每个空格中填写 but 或 yet，辨别一般对照与出人意料的转折。原题为填空，不改成选择题。

items.prompt: 1a. Too much sun damages the skin, ____ many people still do not use sunscreen.
items.instruction: 填写 but 或 yet。
items.answer: yet
items.explanation: 前面说阳光过量会损伤皮肤，后面却说很多人仍不用防晒，突出了令人意外的结果。答案册选 yet。 原书第166页同时说明 but 可表达这两种转折，所以 but 也是可接受表达；yet 更突出本题要练的意外感。
items.sourceLabel: Sentence skills 第10章，书页 167（用法说明见166）（原书 PDF 第 6（说明见5） 页）；Sentence skills answer key 答案书页 30（答案 PDF 第 1 页）

items.prompt: 1b. Too much sun damages the skin, ____ too little sun also causes health problems.
items.instruction: 填写 but 或 yet。
items.answer: but
items.explanation: 这里对照“太多”与“太少”两种情况，不是描述出乎意料的结果，答案册用 but。
items.sourceLabel: Sentence skills 第10章，书页 167（用法说明见166）（原书 PDF 第 6（说明见5） 页）；Sentence skills answer key 答案书页 30（答案 PDF 第 1 页）

items.prompt: 2a. The company’s sales increased last year, ____ its profits declined.
items.instruction: 填写 but 或 yet。
items.answer: yet
items.explanation: 销售额增长通常让人预期利润增长，利润却下降，答案册用 yet 突出反常结果。 原书第166页同时说明 but 可表达这两种转折，所以 but 也是可接受表达；yet 更突出本题要练的意外感。
items.sourceLabel: Sentence skills 第10章，书页 167（用法说明见166）（原书 PDF 第 6（说明见5） 页）；Sentence skills answer key 答案书页 30（答案 PDF 第 1 页）

items.prompt: 2b. The company moved its marketing division to Phoenix, ____ the operations division stayed in Boston.
items.instruction: 填写 but 或 yet。

items.prompt: A.1. The college campus is located in the center of the city so ____
items.instruction: 补写一个有主语和谓语的独立分句，写出完整句并补标点；另写出要圈出的并列连词。
items.answer:
原书第1题示范答案：
The college campus is located in the center of the city, so it is very easy to get there by public transportation.
并列连词：so
items.explanation: 位于市中心是原因，交通方便是结果；so 后面仍要有主语和谓语。

items.prompt: A.2. According to the Big Bang Theory, the universe began expanding about 13.7 billion years ago and ____
items.instruction: 补写一个有主语和谓语的独立分句，写出完整句并补标点；另写出要圈出的并列连词。
items.answer:
答案册示例（合理续写不必逐字相同）：
According to the Big Bang Theory, the universe began expanding about 13.7 billion years ago, and it has been expanding ever since.
并列连词：and
items.explanation: and 补充另一条相关信息；不能只接一个没有主语的短语来代替原要求的独立分句。 答案册此处印作 every since；按固定表达修正为 ever since，已在核对文档记录。

Does the universe have an outer edge, or is it infinite?

items.prompt: C. Write seven compound sentences of your own, using each coordinator once.

items.answer:

The college campus is located in the center of the city; therefore, it is very easy to get there by public transportation.

items.prompt: A.3. Students must pay their tuition and fees before they register for classes otherwise ____

items.answer:

Students must pay their tuition and fees before they register for classes; otherwise, they will have to pay a late fee.

missions.title: Chapter 10 · Practice 7 · Robots 段落编辑
missions.instructions: 改写短文 Robots：尽可能合并原文中较短的句子，尝试把三种并列句连接方法各用至少一次。第13、14句原题指定用 otherwise。保留原意，写出整篇改写稿；存在多种合理答案。

items.prompt: 整文. Robots（原文第1—15句）
items.instruction: 把下方整篇短文改写得更连贯。尝试使用三种方法各至少一次：逗号＋并列连词、分号＋连接副词＋逗号、仅分号。第13、14句必须用 otherwise 合并。提交完整改写稿。
items.answer:
答案册注明 Answers will vary，给出以下局部合并示例，并未提供唯一完整改写稿：
第2＋3句：First of all, robots can perform repetitive tasks without becoming tired or bored; therefore, they are used in automobile factories to weld and paint.
第4＋5句：Robots can also function in hostile environments; as a result, they are useful for exploring the ocean bottom as well as deep outer space.
第8＋9句：For instance, a robot can kill a brain tumor, and it can operate on a fetus with great precision.
第11＋12句：However, robots cannot think conceptually, nor can they function independently.
第13＋14句：Humans have to program them; otherwise, they are useless.
其余句子的合理组合也可接受。原题还要求尝试“仅用分号”这一方法；答案册所列示例没有覆盖它，需另行检查自己的全文。
items.explanation: 先看两句是什么关系，再决定怎么连：2和3是说明用途的因果关系，8和9是并列补充，11和12都是否定，13和14是“否则”的条件后果。不要为了把句子变长而删掉信息。答案册的示例不穷尽所有可行写法。
items.sourceLabel: Sentence skills 第10章，书页 171（原书 PDF 第 10 页）；Sentence skills answer key 答案书页 31—32（答案 PDF 第 2—3 页）
items.passage:
Robots

(1) A robot is a mechanical device that can perform boring, dangerous, and difficult tasks. (2) First of all, robots can perform repetitive tasks without becoming tired or bored. (3) They are used in automobile factories to weld and paint. (4) Robots can also function in hostile environments. (5) They are useful for exploring the ocean bottom as well as deep outer space. (6) Finally, robots can perform tasks requiring pinpoint accuracy. (7) In the operating room, robotic equipment can assist the surgeon. (8) For instance, a robot can kill a brain tumor. (9) It can operate on a fetus with great precision.

(10) The field of artificial intelligence is giving robots a limited ability to think and to make decisions. (11) However, robots cannot think conceptually. (12) Robots cannot function independently. (13) Humans have to program them. (14) They are useless. (15) Therefore, humans should not worry that robots will take over the world—at least not yet.
rubric: 全文保留原文两段的主要信息，句与句衔接自然。
尝试三种并列连接方法各至少一次，并正确使用逗号/分号。
第13、14句用 otherwise 合并，说明不编程就无法工作。
nor 连接否定分句时倒装；不得用一个逗号直接连接两个独立分句。

missions.instructions: 每题同时完成两步：给独立分句部分画实线、从属分句画虚线；再补必要的逗号或分号。文字作答请写“修改后的完整句”，并列出主句部分与从属分句；只补标点不算完成原任务。

items.prompt: 1. Information and communication technology is reaching out to help people in the poorest countries improve their lives for example fishermen on the Bay of Bengal can now receive online weather reports that tell them when it is safe to go out.
items.instruction: 写出补好逗号或分号的完整句；再列出应画实线的主句部分和应画虚线的从属分句。
items.answer:
答案册标点：
Information and communication technology is reaching out to help people in the poorest countries improve their lives; for example, fishermen on the Bay of Bengal can now receive online weather reports that tell them when it is safe to go out.
实线部分（主句主干）：Information and communication technology is reaching out to help people in the poorest countries improve their lives / fishermen on the Bay of Bengal can now receive online weather reports
虚线部分（从属分句）：主层：that tell them when it is safe to go out；其中还有 when it is safe to go out。
items.explanation: for example 在这里连接两个独立分句，前面用分号、后面用逗号。that 修饰 reports；when 从句说明报告告诉渔民什么。答案册的实线还把衔接语 for example 标在第二主句一侧。

独立部分、从属部分都已标出，嵌入的定语从句不遗漏。
不把短语或同一主语的并列谓语误当成独立分句。

items.prompt: 2. Furthermore, when the fishermen bring in a boatload of fish they can find out the current market prices for their fish, which will help them bargain with the middlemen to whom they sell their catch.
items.instruction: 写出补好逗号或分号的完整句；再列出应画实线的主句部分和应画虚线的从属分句。
items.answer:
答案册标点：
Furthermore, when the fishermen bring in a boatload of fish, they can find out the current market prices for their fish, which will help them bargain with the middlemen to whom they sell their catch.
实线部分（主句主干）：they can find out the current market prices for their fish
虚线部分（从属分句）：when the fishermen bring in a boatload of fish / which will help them bargain with the middlemen to whom they sell their catch；后者内部还有 to whom they sell their catch。
items.explanation: 句首 when 时间从句在 fish 后结束，需要逗号。which 补充说明查到价格的作用；to whom 修饰 middlemen。Furthermore 是衔接副词，本身不是从属引导词。

items.prompt: 3. The cost of the cheapest computer is at least $200 and since this is more than an individual fisherman can afford several fishing villages together can pool their money and buy one to share.
items.instruction: 写出补好逗号或分号的完整句；再列出应画实线的主句部分和应画虚线的从属分句。

The cost of the cheapest computer is at least $200, and since this is more than an individual fisherman can afford, several fishing villages together can pool their money and buy one to share.

items.prompt: 5. When you call your U.S. bank you may find yourself speaking to a customer service representative who is sitting in the Philippines or Puerto Rico and when you need technical support for your home computer you will probably get help from a programmer in New Delhi.
items.instruction: 写出补好逗号或分号的完整句；再列出应画实线的主句部分和应画虚线的从属分句。

items.prompt: B. Nonverbal Communication（四段短文改写）
items.instruction: 用你学过的不同合句方法改善下方四段短文，减少过多的短简单句；保留原意，提交整篇改写稿。
items.answer:
答案册参考改写（Answers will vary）：
Nonverbal communication, or body language, is used everywhere in the world. It is a very powerful means of communication, for it communicates much more than spoken words.

One example of nonverbal communication is what occurs between parents and child. When parents smile at their child, they communicate love, acceptance, and reassurance. The child feels comfortable and safe since the smile signifies approval; therefore, the child is happy and well adjusted.

Another example of such communication is the image a person shows in public. When a woman is walking alone on an unfamiliar, possibly dangerous street and wants to appear confident, she walks quickly even though she may be tired. She walks with her shoulders straight, her head held high, and her eyes focused straight ahead. If someone is looking at her, she returns the glance without hesitation. In contrast, a nervous woman appears afraid if she walks slowly with her shoulders and eyes down.

Indeed, body language can express more than spoken language. Merely by raising an eyebrow, clenching a jaw, or softening the eyes, a person can express disapproval, anger, or love. It is a very strong method of communication.

答案册对第4段注明“No changes to the concluding paragraph.”，所以这里原样保留结尾段。

items.prompt: 原题 1：(a) Gasoline became expensive. (b) Automobile manufacturers began to produce smaller cars. (c) Smaller cars use less gasoline.

items.answer:
Equal / Not equal? Not equal.
Main idea: (b).
Relationships: (a) time (when) or reason (because); (c) reason (because) or descriptive information (which).
Combined sentence: When gasoline became more expensive, automobile manufacturers began to produce smaller cars because they use less gasoline.
items.explanation: 重点是厂家开始制造小型车；油价上涨说明背景或原因，小型车省油说明这样做的理由。先确定主句再安放两条辅助信息。教材示范合并句增加 more，原题 (a) 保留 expensive。

items.prompt: 原题 Editing·第1段：The United States: Melting Pot or Salad Bowl?
items.instruction: 找出本段有问题的句子，写出原句号与错误类型；然后重写完整段落，纠正平行结构及其他句子问题。注意：并非每句都有错。
items.answer:
定位：第1句 stringy；第2、7句 comma splice；第5、6句 choppy，可合并。
参考改写：The United States counts its population every ten years, and each census reveals that the racial and ethnic mix is changing dramatically. Therefore, by the year 2050, the “average” person in the United States will not be descended from Europeans; instead, the majority of U.S. residents will trace their ancestry to Africa, Asia, the Hispanic world, the Pacific Islands, or the Middle East. Once the United States was a microcosm of European nationalities; however, today the United States is a microcosm of the world. The United States is no longer considered a “melting pot” society by many of its residents. Instead, many people prefer the term “salad bowl.” They use this term to describe U.S. society, which will soon be predominantly nonwhite. “Melting pot” implies that the different ethnic groups blend together into one homogeneous mixture; on the other hand, “salad bowl” implies that nationalities, like the ingredients in a mixed green salad, retain their cultural identities.
items.explanation: 第1句连续 and/so/but 太长，先把人口变化与预测分组；第2、7句是两个独立句只靠逗号连接；第6句补充 society 的特点，可用 which 接到第5句。第3、4句无需强行改错。
items.passage: (1) The United States counts its population every 10 years, and each census reveals that the racial and ethnic mix is changing dramatically, so by the year 2050, the “average” person in the United States will not be descended from Europeans, but the majority of U.S. residents will trace their ancestry to Africa, Asia, the Hispanic world, the Pacific Islands, or the Middle East. (2) Once the United States was a microcosm of European nationalities, today the United States is a microcosm of the world. (3) The United States is no longer considered a “melting pot” society by many of its residents. (4) Instead, many people prefer the term “salad bowl.” (5) They use this term to describe U.S. society. (6) U.S. society will soon be predominantly nonwhite. (7) “Melting pot” implies that the different ethnic groups blend together into one homogeneous mixture, “salad bowl” implies that nationalities, like the ingredients in a mixed green salad, retain their cultural identities.
